With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 16 mm Port Thread Type: Rc [Or M5x0.8 for 12, 16 Bores] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 30 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

Description:

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing) Bore Size: diameter 20 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 100 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Title: SMC MGPL20TF-25AZ CMP GDE+AIR CUSH Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPL20TF-25AZ
DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing) Bore Size: diameter 20 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 25 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Title: SMC MGPL32TF-100AZ COMPACT GUIDE CY Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPL32TF-100AZ
DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing) Bore Size: diameter 32 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 100 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

PART NUMBER: MGPL40TF-100Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 40 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 100 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

Title: SMC AW30-F03BE-B FILTER REGULATOR Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: AW30-F03BE-B
DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Made to Order 1: None Body Size: 30 Backflow Function: None Thread: F (G) Port: 03 (3/8) Option: BE (w/Bracket + Square embedded type pressure gauge [with limit indicator]) Semi-standard 1: Standard Semi-standard 2: Standard Made to Order 2: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Title: SMC MGPL63TF-100Z COMPACT GUIDE CY Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPL63TF-100Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 63 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 100 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 100 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 25 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 100 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 50 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

Title: SMC MGPM12-30Z GUIDED CYLINDER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPM12-30Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 12 mm Port Thread Type: Rc [Or M5x0.8 for 12, 16 Bores] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 30 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPM16-80Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 16 mm Port Thread Type: Rc [Or M5x0.8 for 12, 16 Bores] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 80 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Title: SMC AW30-F03DEH-B FILTER REGULATOR Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: AW30-F03DEH-B
DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Made to Order 1: None Body Size: 30 Backflow Function: None Thread: F (G) Port: 03 (3/8) Option: DEH (Float Type Auto Drain [N.O.] + Square embedded type pressure gauge [with limit indicator] + w/Set Nut, for Panel Mount) Semi-standard 1: Standard Semi-standard 2: Standard Made to Order 2: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 20 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 50 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-A is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator
  • Integrated filter and regulator save space
  • Requires less piping
  • Optional embedded pressure gauge
  • Available with built-in backflow mechanism
  • Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads

The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
